controls.label: Count
controls.description: Sets the number of independent tracer lifetimes, up to four.

controls.label: Speed
controls.description: Sets how quickly each tracer head advances through canvas-height space.

controls.label: Curl
controls.description: Sets the stable curvature chosen for each lifetime.

controls.label: Sway
controls.description: Sets a subtle shared-body movement without changing the deposited route.

controls.label: Seed
controls.description: Chooses perimeter entries, headings, pigments, and hatch families.

controls.label: Width
controls.description: Sets the full ribbon width in canvas-height units.

controls.label: Pace
controls.description: Scales artistic time while deposition timestamps remain scene seconds.

controls.label: Contrast
controls.description: Moves each lifetime pigment from quiet watercolor toward a clearer accent.

controls.label: Hatching
controls.description: Sets the opacity and weight of the lifetime-seeded hatch family.

controls.label: Bleed
controls.description: Adds a broad translucent pigment spread around the ribbon.

metadata.label: Living Painting
metadata.description: Organic watercolor regions that adopt new colors and hatch styles when shared tracer paths cross them.

paths.label: Paths
paths.description: Shared tracer geometry used to carve the regions.

image.label: Image
image.description: The painting before tracer ink is composited.

controls.label: Tension and release
controls.description: Slow build, crest, release, and rest. Shapes lead; linework and color follow.

controls.label: Tension
controls.description: Strength of local pressure, contrasting line directions, and rhythmic compression.

controls.label: Large and small rhythm
controls.description: Large anchor regions alternate with smaller supporting regions.

controls.label: Average spacing
controls.description: Overall spacing scale. Each region keeps its own spacing ratio.

controls.label: Overall bend
controls.description: Strength of distinct regional styles: restrained lines, sweeping curves, fans, and contours.

controls.label: Direction bias
controls.description: Shifts the overall direction while preserving regional relationships.

controls.label: Average ink weight
controls.description: Overall stroke weight. Dense patterns tend toward finer strokes; open patterns can carry heavier marks.

controls.label: Neighboring harmony
controls.description: Neighboring patterns share direction, with occasional opposing accents.

metadata.label: Wandering Tracer Paths
